scope: One deployment fact: this project's MySQL container had enough time to close itself during `docker compose stop`. No Go code, no image definition and no other service changed.

deliberately_unchanged: volume name gopherlearn-mysql-8b1-data and container name gopherlearn-mysql-8b1
the standalone start: docker compose --env-file .env.mysql.local -f compose.mysql.yml up -d --wait

why_the_number: Docker's default is 10s between SIGTERM and SIGKILL. Measured in 8C and 8C.1, that produced container exit 137 for this image: the rows were all still there, but the exit status is what an operator reads as a crash, and a killed InnoDB has to do recovery work on the next start that a shut-down one does not.

static_gate.asserts: stop_grace_period present and >= 30s, and the digest/port/charset/healthcheck/volume/container-name are untouched
static_gate.overlay_rule: compose.app.yml may repeat the window but must never shorten it

mutations_run.result: fails stating the service has no stop_grace_period

measured.volume_used: gopherlearn-8c2-mysql-data (created empty for this round, through a throwaway overlay that renamed only the volume and the container)
measured.migration: the backend binary migrated 14 tables into a fresh schema on this volume
measured.utf8mb4_round_trip: a 44-rune message containing Chinese, an emoji and a four-byte character round-tripped through the API byte-identically; no replacement characters in those rows

idle_stop.log: Received SHUTDOWN from user <via user signal>. Shutting down mysqld (Version: 8.0.46). then Shutdown complete

stop_with_open_transaction.log: the same SHUTDOWN/Shutdown complete pair, 3rd occurrence across this container's life
stop_with_open_transaction.client_observed: SELECT SLEEP(25) returned interrupted (1) and the session ended with 'Bye' before COMMIT was acknowledged
stop_with_open_transaction.interpretation: the transaction is decided as a whole: rolled back here, and the committed data was never in doubt. A partially applied transaction is not a state this run could produce or observe.

gates.go_test_default_without_docker: 20 packages ok; the real-MySQL tests skip with a reason when GOPHERLEARN_MYSQL_INTEGRATION_DSN is unset
gates.mysql_gated_integration_suite: 250 PASS lines / 0 FAIL against MySQL 8.0.46 on this round's container

observations_out_of_scope: A request body that is not valid UTF-8 is accepted and stored as replacement characters rather than refused: the first write in this round reached the server through a Git Bash argument in the console codepage and stored U+FFFD runs. That is a client-side transport defect, and the retry from a UTF-8 file round-tripped cleanly - but the server's choice to sanitise rather than reject is a real input-validation question for another round, not something 8C.2 touched.
This record says nothing about the SSE proxy-buffering question left open in docker-stack-v1.json; that limitation is unchanged.
